title: stathmostelma katangense
intro: Stathmostelma katangense, commonly known as Katanga Stathmostelma or Katanga Stathmostela, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in African herbal medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Stathmostelma katangense include its potential to reduce inflammation, fight off bacterial infections, and alleviate fever, due to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antipyretic therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties are yet to be fully identified, but they are likely to include alkaloids and other phytochemicals found in plants of the Apocynaceae family.
